content:
Overview

Tralee is a city in Kerry with a population of 24,000. The gateway to the Ring of Kerry, a lively market town with a beautiful town park, the Kerry County Museum, and stunning coastal and mountain scenery. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Sunshine is limited, with about 145 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
